system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is Negotiator, Courtesan, or Demon Lord.

When you do an Opposed [Negotiation check], you use this skill on the person opposing. Choose one status [Dazed] or [Overconfident] and give it to the target. 

(Connection: Target): The limit of this skill is never used on this target and can even be used after it has been.

A special skill that guides the opponent's mind with skillful speech and draws out the answer you want.
